name: App Icon: FLUX Lone Straw-Hat Ronin
purpose: Primary App Icon — FLUX.1 [schnell] Reference Stance.
description: Standing solid pitch-black silhouette of a master samurai in conical straw hat with dual katanas, framed inside a glowing pure solid crimson-red solar circle on deep black canvas.
prompt: A masterwork minimalist 2D flat vector game app icon. Pure solid pitch-black silhouette of a samurai warrior standing firmly, wearing a traditional wide conical straw hat, carrying sleek katana swords. Centered inside a giant solid flat bright red circular sun disc (#FF2035). Pure solid pitch-black background (#000000). Duotone color palette of pure black and vibrant bright red only. Crisp clean vector edges, stencil silhouette, no 3D rendering, no soft painting, no human face, no text, no watermark.
